input: Set up a telescope for backyard stargazing nights

gold.taskTitle: Set Up Telescope for Backyard Stargazing Nights
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to set up a telescope in their backyard for regular stargazing sessions at night.

questions.title: Do you already own a telescope, or need to buy one?
questions.description: Determines whether the plan starts with purchasing equipment or setting up existing gear.

questions.title: What objects do you most want to observe?
questions.description: Identifies the primary stargazing targets such as planets, deep-sky objects, the Moon, or star clusters.

questions.title: How much light pollution is in your backyard?
questions.description: Assesses the viewing environment to set expectations and guide equipment choices.

questions.title: What is your total budget for this setup?
questions.description: Defines the financial scope covering telescope, accessories, and any supporting equipment.

questions.title: How much experience do you have with telescopes?
questions.description: Gauges the user's skill level to tailor the complexity of the setup and learning steps.

questions.title: Will the telescope be stored indoors between sessions?
questions.description: Clarifies storage and portability needs, which affect the type and size of telescope recommended.

questions.title: Do you want to photograph what you see through the telescope?
questions.description: Determines whether astrophotography capability needs to be factored into the setup plan.
